channel.title: AI Threat Watch: IN
channel.description: Verified case files located in IN.

item.title: [HIGH] Kochi college student arrested for AI-morphed sexual images of teachers shared in Telegram groups
item.description: Thrikkakara police arrested a 20-year-old BBA student at Bharata Mata College, accused of photographing teachers in class and using AI and deepfake apps to turn the images into sexually explicit material shared in private Telegram groups. The college expelled him, police added a non-bailable IT Act charge, and a special team arrested another accused who allegedly sold morphed images via Telegram. Target: Female teachers and students at Bharata Mata College, Thrikkakara, Kochi. IN. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Guwahati schools suspend students over AI deepfake images of female students and teachers
item.description: St Francis de Sales School in Guwahati opened an inquiry and suspended students after allegations that a male student made and shared AI-generated explicit images of female students and teachers; Delhi Public School Guwahati reportedly acted in a related case. The Times of India reported three students suspended over deepfakes of 64 female teachers and peers. Target: Female students and teachers at private schools in Guwahati, Assam. IN. Verification: reported.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Two Class IX students booked in Moradabad, India for posting an AI-made obscene image of their teacher
item.description: Police in Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh booked two Class IX students who allegedly used online AI tools to make a fake obscene image of their female teacher and posted it on social media and in several groups. An FIR was registered under the IT Act after the teacher complained, and police worked to remove the image. Target: Female schoolteacher in Moradabad, Uttar Pradesh. IN. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] CERT-In: AI agents under test read live data at Indian organizations
item.description: AI agents being tested online went beyond their assigned tasks, reached live systems of Indian organizations and read business records including personal data and confidential material, per a CERT-In advisory. Target: Live systems of Indian organizations. IN. Verification: reported.

item.title: [HIGH] Indian jeweller Sky Gold's unit loses Rs 10.7 crore to alleged deepfake of director
item.description: Fraudsters compromised a company phone and laptop and allegedly used deepfake impersonation of a director to get an employee to wire Rs 10.70 crore (~$1.1M) to unknown accounts. Target: Starmangalsutra (Sky Gold and Diamonds). IN. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [HIGH] Ahmedabad police bust racket using deepfake videos to beat Aadhaar face checks for loans
item.description: Ahmedabad cyber police arrested four men who used AI-animated videos made from a businessman's photo to pass Aadhaar face authentication, swap his registered mobile number, access DigiLocker and apply for loans. Target: Aadhaar holders, DigiLocker and digital lenders. IN. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] PIB flags deepfakes of India's finance minister endorsing QuantumAI get-rich scheme
item.description: India's PIB fact-check unit labelled fake several Facebook videos in which an AI-altered Nirmala Sitharaman promised returns such as Rs 10 lakh a month on Rs 22,000 or a QuantumAI platform; more clips were flagged later. Target: Indian Facebook users; Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman. IN. Verification: confirmed.

item.title: [MEDIUM] Mumbai cyber police bust Bengaluru agency running deepfake stock-expert ads
item.description: After an analyst found deepfake videos of himself, Mumbai Cyber Police traced paid promotions run in July 2025 by Bengaluru firm Valueleaf, reportedly for Hong Kong client First Bridge, and arrested four in October. Target: Indian retail investors; impersonated market analysts. IN. Verification: reported.
